name: slide-to-confirm
title: Slide to Confirm
description: Slide-to-confirm control where the thumb must travel the whole track (threshold), a held arrow key stops short of the end, an async confirm shows a pending state, and a rejection slides it back.

meta.summary: Requires the thumb to travel the whole track before confirming, so accidental taps and pocket presses don't send payments.
meta.server: For payments, keep server-side idempotency and authorization; this only reduces accidental triggers.
catches: Taps and short drags that don't reach the threshold
Held arrow keys (auto-repeat) that would otherwise complete it
Repeat confirms while an async confirm is pending
limits: An accidental full slide still confirms
a11y: role=slider with aria-valuenow/valuetext and an aria-label from label
Keyboard operable; holding a key won't complete the slide
Phase text in a polite live region; aria-disabled while locked
